scientific_integrity: The published recurrence and irrationality are credited. New work supplies the Fourier distributional refinement and a certified negative third moment; finite checks are not proof of infinite results.
scientific_limitations: Only factor lengths 4^m sampled uniformly in m, and a waveform-defined limiting distribution. Absolute continuity and closed-form endpoints are not asserted. The third-moment interval is a rigorous sign certificate rather than high-precision decimal determination.
title: A negatively skewed limiting law for the power-scale Abelian complexity of a binary automatic word
